procnotices.notice_text:
REQUEST FOR EXPRESSION OF INTEREST

 

Country:  MOZAMBIQUE

Project:  Mphanda Nkuwa Hydroelectric Project

Agreement: Preparation Advance No. -V522-MZ.

Assignment Title: Individual Consultancy Services to Provision Project Advisor for undertaking the review of the Geotechnical/Geology studies of the planned Mphanda Nkuwa Hydropower Project.

09.03.2026

 

Reference: MZ-GMNK-442363-CS-INDV

 

 

The Government of Mozambique (GoM) hereinafter referred to as “the Borrower” have received Advance funds from International Development Association (IDA) towards the costs of the Mphanda Nkuwa Hydroelectric Project, Preparation Phase. The funds have been channeled through the Mphanda Nkuwa Hydroelectric Project Office (GMNK) as the Project Implementation Agency, and GMNK intends to apply part of the proceeds for Consulting Services for providing Project Advisory for undertaking the review of the Geotechnical/Geology studies of the planned Mphanda Nkuwa Hydropower Project.

 

The GMNK now invites eligible Individual Consultant (“Consultants”) to express their interest in providing the Services. Interested Individual Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the services. The shortlisting criteria are:

 

  1. Minimum of Post Graduate Degree in the relevant engineering disciplines and must have at least 25 years of professional experience relevant to the assignment.
  2. Experience of working in sub-Sahara Africa.
  3. Proven understanding of World Bank panels is preferred and familiarity with World Bank policies is a must
  4. Experts must be fluent in verbal and written English Knowledge of Mozambique’s national environmental and social regulations and permitting requirements.
  5. strong communication skills with senior government officials and large groups of people, and ability to organize and conduct technical workshops/meetings related to panel findings

 

Evidence shall be attached as supporting documents for the Expression of Interest.

 

Objective

 

The Project is being prepared for seeking financial support of the World Bank (the “Bank”) and therefore must comply with the World Bank Safeguards Policies and Performance Standards (see the concept project information document stage at the WB website [1]).  Accordingly, the Mphanda Nkuwa Project needs to comply with the World Bank Environmental and Social Framework (ESF) – Community Health and Safety (ESS4[2]). To this effect two panel of experts (PoEs) need to be formed: (i) Panel of Experts for Dam Safety (PoE-DS); and (ii) Panel of Experts for Environmental and Social Management (PoE-ESM).

Key Responsibilities/ Scope of Reviews

 

The Environmental Expert will:

                               

  1. Review of quality and sufficiency of geological investigations and interpretation thereof, and engineering implications with respect to foundation design, stability of natural slopes, including in the reservoir areas, and excavated slopes, and support of surface and underground excavations.

 

  1. Review of determination of maximum credible and design basis earthquakes, including determination of seismic loading criteria.

 

  1. Review of design of surface and underground excavations, including of temporary and permanent support systems and linings.

 

  1. Review sensitivity and risk analyses on key geotechnical parameters, verifying the adequacy of methods, the reliability of results and the effectiveness of proposed mitigation measures.

 

  1. Review of the construction schedules and estimated unit rates related to excavations, foundation, support and underground works.

 

  1. Review of the technical specifications related to excavations, foundation, support, and underground works.

 

Specific subjects on which the PoE is expected to comment, but not limited to, are listed in the Terms of Reference.

 

Expected Assignment Timeline

 

The assignment is for a period of six (6) years, covering project preparation, construction, and initial reservoir filling. The initial contract will be signed for a period of 2 years, with the potential for an extension to cover the full duration of preparation and implementation. The contract will be time-based, with an annual ceiling of 20 working days, subject to extension if needed.

 

Detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment can be obtained at the address given below.

 

The attention of interest is drawn to Section III, paragraphs 3.14, 3.16 and 3.17 of the World Bank՚s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” - September 2023 (“Procurement Regulations”), setting for the World Bank`s policy on conflict of interest.

 

The Consultant will be selected in accordance with ICS – Individual Consultant Selection method set out in the Procurement Regulations.

 

Further information can be obtained at the address below during office hours 08:30 to 15:00.

 

Expression of Interest must be delivered in a written form to the address below (in person, or by e-mail) by April 7, 2026, 14:00 local time, and be clearly marked “Individual Consultancy Services to Provision Project Advisor for undertaking the review of the Geotechnical/Geology studies for the planned Mphanda Nkuwa Hydropower Project.”

 

The addresses referred to above are as follows:

 

Gabinete de Implementação do Projecto Hidroeléctrico de Mphanda Nkuwa (GMNK)

Rua dos Desportistas, No918, Edifício JAT V-3, 1o Andar, Maputo - Mozambique

REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST (CONSULTING SERVICES – FIRM SELECTION)

 

BADAN INFORMASI GEOSPASIAL

THE GEOSPATIAL INFORMATION AGENCY

INTEGRATED LAND ADMINISTRATION AND SPATIAL PLANNING PROJECT (ILASPP)

Loan No./Credit No./Grant No: 9732-ID

 

Assignment Title: Consulting Services for Geospatial Capacity Enhancement

Reference No.: ID-BIG-539676-CS-QCBS

 

The Government of Indonesia has received financing in the amount of USD 653 million from the World Bank toward the cost of the Integrated Land Administration and Spatial Planning Project (ILASPP) and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services, namely Consulting Services for Geospatial Capacity Enhancement.

1) The objective of implementing the Geospatial Capacity Enhancement activities is to enhance Indonesia's geospatial capabilities in facing the climate crisis as part of efforts to establish a Future geospatial ecosystem by strengthening the implementation (adoption and adaptation) of the Integrated Geospatial Information Framework (IGIF).

2) Scope of Works:
Geospatial Capacity Enhancement activity consists of five activities, namely:

  1. Activity A: Formulating future directions for initiating the development of Indonesia's geospatial ecosystem through several targets, namely:
    1. Target 1: Assessment of current geospatial capacity; it is conducted at the national/country level based on political, economic, social, and technological conditions as part of identifying the basis for formulating the direction of the future geospatial ecosystem in Indonesia;
    2. Target 2: Developing a grand design for the development of Indonesia's future geospatial ecosystem; and
    3. Target 3: Developing a Country-level Action Plan based on the grand design for the development of Indonesia's future geospatial ecosystem with implementation pathways for climate-informed geospatial applications.
       
  2. Activity B: Capacity enhancement of the Center for Geospatial Information Competence Development towards a future geospatial ecosystem, covering two targets, namely:
    1. Target 4: Formulating a master plan for increasing the capacity of geospatial information competency development units towards a future geospatial ecosystem; and
    2. Target 5: Developing the required capacity enhancement instruments and its implementation through structured programs.
       
  3. Activity C: Implementing capacity enhancement of Indonesian geospatial ecosystem components as an implementation based on future direction.
    Target 6: The components of the geospatial ecosystem consist of the people ecosystem, stakeholders ecosystem (for i.e. government, industries, and academia), data, technology, policy & standard, operation ecosystem, and decision-centric ecosystem. The capacity enhancement will be carried out at both the national and local levels in Indonesia.
     
  4. Activity D: The development of the Indonesian Geospatial Hub.
    Target 7: Developing Indonesian Geospatial Hub for downstream use of Geospatial Information as a real form of geospatial ecosystem, by forming a committee, preparing an academic study, establishing a website, performing market research, and holding a “Geospatial Hub” forum/conference.
     
  5. Activity E: Reporting.
    Target 8: Mandatory reports that must be provided by service providers as presented in Term of Reference (ToR) Appendix 5, including Inception Report, Quarterly Report, and Final/Project Completion Report.

3) The approximate duration of the assignment is expected to be completed within 36 months from the date of the contract signing. However, this timeline is an estimate and may be subject to adjustments.

4) The ILASPP Project Implementation Unit (PIU) now invites eligible institutions/consulting firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services.
The qualifications of Service Providers that must be met in this activity are as follows:

  1. Have at least 5 years of experience in the field of geospatial-related fields and/or geospatial information management with national or international qualifications;
  2. Have work experience in developing a framework or implementing the utilization of geospatial information, geospatial strategy, geospatial policy, or geospatial standard. Demonstrated experience in developing a learning system or learning design would be an advantage;
  3. Have work experience in capacity building in the field of geospatial information;

The Expression of Interest (EOI) must include the following:

  1. EOI Cover Letter: Clearly stating the intention to participate and specifying whether the submission is by a single firm or a Joint Venture (JV). The letter must be complete with the signature of the authorized representative.
  2. Firm’s Profile: Brief profile, core business, and years in business.

9) The Consulting Firm will be selected in accordance with the Quality and Cost-Based Selection (QCBS) method described in the Procurement Regulations.

10) Expressions of Interest (EOI) should be submitted in English and send to https://spseicb.lkpp.go.id/spseicb/ by April 7, 2026, 12:00 WIB at the latest.

procnotices.notice_text:
SOLICITUD DE EXPRESIONES DE INTERES

SERVICIOS DE CONSULTORÍA

República Dominicana

Proyecto de Respuesta a Emergencias y Resiliencia de la República Dominicana

Préstamo No.: 9473-DO

Título del Trabajo: Contratación de la consultoría técnica para la ejecución de estudios y diseños de las obras: Reconstrucción del camino vecinal Los Lanos – Los Naranjos, municipio Castillo, provincia Duarte; Rehabilitación del camino vecinal El Guanito -Guarapito, municipio Higüey, provincia la Altagracia; y Rehabilitación del camino vecinal Mata Palacio – El Puerto, municipio Hato Mayor del Rey, provincia Hato Mayor.

No. de Referencia: DO-MINPRE-535612-CS-LCS

El Gobierno de República Dominicana ha recibido financiamiento del Banco Mundial para cubrir el costo del Proyecto de Respuesta a Emergencias y Resiliencia de la República Dominicana a través del Ministerio de la Presidencia, y tiene la intención de aplicar parte de los fondos a la contratación de servicios de consultoría.

Los servicios de consultoría (“los Servicios”) comprenden la realización de estudios y diseño de  5.30 km del tramo vial sector Los Lanos-Los Naranjos en el municipio de Castillo, Provincia Duarte; 7.30 km del tramo vial sector Guanito-Guarapito en el municipio de Higüey, Provincia La Altagracia,: y de 9.18 km del tramo vial sector Mata Palacio-El Puerto en el municipio de Hato Mayor del Rey, Provincia Hato Mayor, en el marco del Proyecto de Respuesta a Emergencias y Resiliencia de la República Dominicana, en un periodo de cuatro (4) meses, lo que garantiza la total coherencia con los Términos de Referencia adjuntos o a los que se hace referencia en esta Solicitud de Expresiones de Interés (SDEI). Esta descripción es de carácter general; el detalle de los alcances y especificaciones técnicas se encuentra en los Términos de Referencia (TdR) que se anexan a la presente solicitud.

El Ministerio de la Presidencia ahora invita a las firmas consultoras elegibles ("Consultores") a indicar su interés en proporcionar los Servicios. Los Consultores interesados ​​deben proporcionar información que demuestre que tienen las calificaciones requeridas y la experiencia relevante para prestar los Servicios. Los criterios de preselección son: actividad principal y años en el negocio y experiencia relevante, capacidad técnica y de gestión de la empresa.

Nota: Los Expertos Clave no serán evaluados en la etapa de preselección.

Para estos fines se requiere que la empresa remita la siguiente documentación:

  • Carta de expresión de interés, con datos generales de la empresa (firmada)
  • Detalle de experiencia de la empresa donde se evidencie: actividad principal y años en el negocio, experiencia relevante, capacidad técnica y de gestión de la empresa.
  • Estructura organizativa de la empresa con una breve descripción del equipo de consultores de la firma.
  • Registro mercantil actualizado o equivalente en su país de origen
  • Nómina de accionistas o documento equivalente en su país de origen

Nota: Toda la documentación que se presente deberá estar en idioma español.

La lista corta contendrá mínimo cinco (5) empresas a ser preseleccionadas a ocho (8) como máximo de empresas a ser preseleccionadas.

Se llama la atención de los Consultores interesados ​​sobre la Sección III, párrafos 3.14, 3.16 y 3.17 de las “Regulaciones de Adquisiciones para Prestatarios en Proyectos de Inversión del Banco Mundial, actualizada a noviembre 2020 (“Regulaciones de Adquisiciones”), que establece la política del Banco Mundial sobre conflictos de intereses. Además, consulte la siguiente información específica sobre conflictos de intereses relacionados con esta cesión: según el párrafo 3.17 de las Regulaciones de Adquisiciones.

Los consultores pueden asociarse con otras firmas para mejorar sus calificaciones, pero deben indicar claramente si la asociación tiene la forma de una asociación, asociación en participación, consorcio o asociación (Joint Venture) APCA y/o una subconsultoría. En el caso de una APCA, todos los socios de la empresa conjunta serán solidariamente responsables de todo el contrato, si son seleccionados.

Se puede obtener más información o solicitar aclaraciones sobre los términos de referencia, mediante comunicación escrita dirigida al correo electrónico adquisicioneseyr@minpre.gob.do.

Las expresiones de interés deben enviarse al correo electrónico adquisicioneseyr@minpre.gob.do a más tardar el 31 de marzo de 2026 hasta las 3:00 p.m. (GMT-4).

AVIS GÉNÉRAL DE PASSATION DES MARCHÉS

Pays                            :    Madagascar

Nom du projet             :    Projet de Transport Multimodal et Logistique (PTML)

                                        Ministère des Transports et de la Météorologie

Projet / financement    :    P512330

Le Gouvernement de la République de Madagascar a sollicité un financement de l’Association Internationale de Développement (IDA) pour la mise en œuvre du Projet de Transport Multimodal et Logistique (PTML), et a l’intention d’utiliser une partie de ce financement pour effectuer des paiements au titre des marchés de travaux, de fournitures et de services de consultants à attribuer dans le cadre du projet.

Le Projet de Transport Multimodal et Logistique (PTML) vise à améliorer la performance, la résilience et la sécurité des infrastructures de transport ferroviaire, maritime, fluvial et aérien à Madagascar, ainsi qu’à renforcer les compétences et l’emploi dans le secteur des travaux publics. Les principales composantes du Projet sont :

  • Composante 1 – Modernisation et réforme du transport ferroviaire
  • Composante 2 – Réhabilitation des ports, réouverture des voies navigables et réforme du transport maritime et fluvial
  • Composante 3 – Modernisation des aéroports régionaux et appui au secteur du transport aérien
  • Composante 4 – Appui à la coordination du projet et à la réinstallation

Les marchés à passer dans le cadre du PTML comprennent notamment :

  • Marchés de travaux, incluant entre autres : Travaux de réhabilitation d’infrastructures portuaires ; Travaux d’aménagement et de réhabilitation de canaux fluviaux ; Travaux de réhabilitation d’infrastructures aéroportuaires ; Travaux ferroviaires (voies, ouvrages, équipements associés).
  • Marchés de fournitures, incluant notamment : Fourniture de rails, traverses, appareils de voie et équipements ferroviaires ; Fourniture d’équipements portuaires et fluviaux ; Fourniture d’équipements de sécurité et d’aide à la navigation aérienne et fluviale ; Fourniture de matériels roulants et d’équipements spécialisés.
  • Contrats de services de consultants, incluant : Maîtrise d’œuvre complète, études techniques et environnementales ; Missions de contrôle et de surveillance des travaux ; Assistance technique et renforcement des capacités institutionnelles.

La liste détaillée des activités prévues, avec les estimations de coûts, les méthodes de passation et les modalités de revue par la Banque mondiale, figure dans les Plans de Passation des Marchés (PPM) du projet.

La passation des marchés financés par la Banque mondiale se déroulera selon les procédures spécifiées dans le Règlement de passation des marchés de la Banque mondiale pour les emprunteurs du FPI (Septième édition, Septembre 2025) (Règlement de passation des marchés), et est ouvert à toutes les entreprises et particuliers éligibles tels que définis dans le Règlement de passation des marchés. Après les négociations du projet, la Banque mondiale organisera la publication sur son site Web externe du plan de passation de marchés initial convenu et publiera également toutes les mises à jour ultérieures une fois qu’elle aura émis un non objection.

Des avis de marchés spécifiques pour les marchés soumis à un appel par mise en concurrence international ouvert seront annoncés dès qu’ils seront disponibles, en ligne sur le site Web externe de la Banque mondiale, ainsi que dans les journaux de diffusion nationale appropriés en l’occurrence Midi Madagasikara et Express de Madagascar.

Les entreprises éligibles et les personnes physiques intéressées qui souhaiteraient être prise en considération pour la fourniture des biens, de travaux, de services autres que de consultant et de service de consultant pour le projet susmentionné, ou celles qui ont besoin d’informations supplémentaires peuvent contacter l’emprunteur à l’adresse ci-dessous :

The Ministry of Water and Irrigation has received financing from the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (World Bank), the Agence Française de Développement (AFD) and Global Concessional Financing Facility (GCFF) in the amount of US$300,000,000 to be managed by the World Bank, toward the cost of the Jordan Water Sector Efficiency Project, and it intends to apply part of the proceeds to payments for consulting services to be procured under this project.

The consulting services (“the Services”) objective is to provide engineering services, design review, planning, and construction supervision to the Miyahuna to ensure an effective implementation of the following packages:

Package 1: Design and build of Water Networks in Al Hizam DZ02

Package 2: Design and Build of Water Networks in Northern Al-Salt Areas / Balqa Governorate

The Services under these terms of Reference are proposed to be carried out in as indicated below for the two packages listed above.

The Consultant shall develop a Project Management Plan for each package, to adopt during the implementation of the project, which will be composed of 3 main phases: design review and approval, construction stage and defects liability.

Environmental and Social (E&S) supervision is a core function of this assignment. The Consultant shall be fully responsible for ensuring that all project activities comply with the World Bank Environmental and Social Framework (ESF), including all relevant Environmental and Social Standards (ESS1–ESS10), and with the Project’s ESMF, LMP, SEP, RPF, ESCP, ESMP, and CESMP. E&S supervision shall be carried out in all stages of the design review, construction supervision, and defect liability period, and shall carry equal importance to engineering supervision.

The TOR full version can be found on Jordan Water Company-Miyahuna (www.miyahuna.com.jo) website at the following link https://www.miyahuna.com.jo/ar/modules/tenders

The Jordan Water Company- Miyahuna now invites eligible consulting firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services. Consultant Brochures may also be included in the EOI. The shortlisting criteria are:

  • Similar assignments, (in similar physical environment as in Jordan is preferred)
  • Relevance of the firm’s core business and general experience
  • Years of experience in similar business.
  • Availability of appropriate skills among consultant’s technical staff. (Submission of the long list of relevant technical staff and their expertise has added value).

It is preferable to limit the EoI to a maximum of 50 pages.

Please note that at this shortlisting stage: Technical and financial proposals are not requested. Key Experts, if proposed for the assignment, will not be evaluated. Request for clarifications on the EOI shall not be replied to.

The shortlist will contain 5 to 8 firms.

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to Section III, paragraphs, 3.14, 3.16, and 3.17 of the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” November 2020 (“Procurement Regulations”), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest. 

Consultants may associate with other firms to enhance their qualifications but should indicate clearly whether the association is in the form of a joint venture and/or a sub-consultancy. In the case of a joint venture, all the partners in the joint venture shall be jointly and severally liable for the entire contract, if selected.

The Applicant’s attention is drawn to the following:

  1. Interested National consulting engineering firms that wish to apply, singularly, as part of Joint Venture, or as Sub-Consultant, in addition to requirements as defined in this request for Expression of Interest, should be classified as First Grade (1) in the field of Water and Waste Water as per the Government Tender Directorate (GTD) classification system

Shortlisted Consultants will be invited to submit their proposals, upon which a Consultant will be selected in accordance with the (QCBS) described in the “World Bank Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers”, dated November 2020" and to be specifically set out in the Request for Proposals.

AVIS DE DEMANDE DE COTATIONS

N°018/ADC/MINTP/CSPM-PFC/2026 DU09 MARCH 2026

POUR L’ACQUISITION DE SIX VÉHICULES DONT QUATRE PICK-UP ET DEUX BERLINES POUR LA POLICE ET LA GENDARMERIE EN DEUX LOTS DISTINCTS.

  1. Consultation du Dossier de Demande de Cotations

La République du Cameroun a obtenu de la Banque Mondiale (BAD) un financement pour le Projet de Développement du Secteur des Transports (PDST). Il est prévu qu’une partie du montant de ce Prêt soit utilisée pour effectuer les paiements attendus au titre de l’acquisition de six véhicules dont quatre pick-up et deux berlines pour la police et la gendarmerie en deux lots distincts.

Le dossier de Demande de Cotations peut être consulté gratuitement aux heures ouvrables auprès des services du Maître d’Ouvrage, Direction des Contrats, Cellule des Appels d’Offres, 4ème étage de l’immeuble siège du Ministère des Travaux Publics, sise à Etoudi, Téléphone : (237) 222 22 92 34, pendant les jours ouvrables, entre 08 heures et 15 heures, dès publication du présent Avis.

  1. Participation et retrait du dossier.

La consultation est ouverte exclusivement aux compagnies d’assurance répondant aux critères de qualification indiqués dans le dossier de Demande de Cotations qui sera retirée gratuitement.

  1. Langue de l’Offre

L'offre, ainsi que tous les documents qui la composent, doit être rédigée en langue française ou anglaise.

  1. Date, heure et conditions de dépôt des offres

Les Offres doivent être déposées en huit (08) exemplaires (dont un (01) original et sept (07) copies plus une copie numérique), à l’adresse ci-dessous, en personne, par courrier, au plus tard le 16 avril 2026, à 10 heures, heure locale. Elles doivent être transmises avec la mention :

« DEMANDE DE COTATIONS N°018/DC/MINTP/CSPM-PFC/2026

POUR L’ACQUISITION DE SIX VEHICULES DONT QUATRE PICK-UP ET DEUX BERLINES POUR LA POLICE ET LA GENDARMERIE EN DEUX LOTS DISTINCTS »

A N’OUVRIR UNIQUEMENT QU’EN SEANCE DE DEPOUILLEMENT

L’adresse de dépôt des cotations est :

Ministère des Travaux Publics, Direction des Contrats,

Cellule des Appels d’Offres,

4ème étage de l’immeuble siège du Ministère des Travaux Publics,

sise à ETOUDI.

Téléphone : (237) 222 22 92 34

  1. Ouverture des plis

Les plis seront ouverts en séance par la Commission Spéciale de Passation des Marchés des Projets à Financement Conjoint, en présence des représentants des Prestataires qui souhaitent assister à l’ouverture le 16 avril 2026, à 11 heures.

REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST

(INDIVIDUAL CONSULTING SERVICES)

Republic of the Marshall Islands 

Strengthening Public Financial Management II 

Loan No./Credit No./ Grant No.: P510280

Assignment Title: Communications Officer (National) 

Reference No. (as per Procurement Plan): MH-PFM PMO-534322-CS-INDV

The Government of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) has received financing from the World Bank (WB) toward the cost of the Strengthening Public Financial Management II (P510280) and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services. The Communications Officer will be responsible, under the direction of the PFMII Project Manager, for developing and implementing the PFM II Gender-Sensitive Citizen Engagement Strategy. Further, the Consultant shall create content related to PFM reforms in the form of videos, infographics, press releases, and other forms of content as deemed acceptable by the Client. 

Under the general guidance of the Project Manager, the Consultant will work closely with the Project’s HR Advisor and Gender Advisor and the MOFBPS, including, but not limited to: the Deputy Secretary for Core Financial Services, Assistant Secretaries of Finance, MOFBPS HR Director, CIU, and other line ministries and international development partners as needed to identify, develop, and manage content related to public financial management reforms. These collaborating in discussion with the MOFBPS counterparts to define communication objectives, respond to citizen’s inquiries on the MOFBPS website and social media accounts, edit and proof-read content to ensure that they are grammatically correct and consistent with the professional standards of the MOFBPS, prepare content (audio/visual), maintain and update the MOFBPS website and social media accounts, generate, analyze and report on web traffic.  

The detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment can be obtained at the email address given below.

MIR room 219 or E-mail: rwfitz727@gmail.com

Majuro, Marshall Islands

The (MOFBPS) now invites eligible individuals ("Consultants") to indicate their interest in providing the services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services (attach curriculum vitae (CV) with description of experience in similar assignments, similar conditions, etc.).

 

The criteria for selecting the consultant are:

 

Evaluation Criteria

CVs of all applicants will be evaluated as follows: all CVs will be scrutinized against the assignment’s minimum requirements. The CVs of candidates that meet the minimum requirements will then be scored according to the set scoring criteria. The three candidates with the highest scores will be invited to an interview. The candidate then identified by the interview panel as the most suitable will be invited to negotiate the contract. Referees of the selected candidate may be contacted to verify prior experience, performance, and character traits.

 

Mandatory Requirements

  • An Associate’s degree (or equivalent work experience) in marketing, communications or related field, a Bachelor’s degree in the mentioned fields is a plus;
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in content creation or management of print or digital media platform;
  • Working experience in web design and content management applications is a plus;
  • Proven ability to read and write in English and Marshallese;
  • Knowledge of using photo and video editing software.

Desired Requirements

  • Ability to take quality photos and videos;
  • Experience in graphic design and ability to create designs for digital media purposes;
  • Demonstrated experience developing and implementing social media strategies;
  • Portfolios or examples of work is a plus.

 

Applications should include the following documents and be submitted before 5:00 pm Majuro Time, March 31, 2026. The email subject line should state: “(PFM II) Communications Officer Position- full name of the candidate.”

  • Cover Letter 
  • CV

Government of the People's Republic of Bangladesh

Office of the Project Director, Ministry of Local Government, Rural Development and Cooperatives (Local Government Division)

Project Preparatory Study for Metro Dhaka Water Security and Resilience Program

Room-907, DWASA Bhaban,98, Kazi Nazrul Islam Avenue, Kawran Bazar, Dhaka-1215

E-mail: metrodhakapm@gmail.com

 

 

Memo no: 48.113.640.00.00.03.2026.01                                                                         Date: 15/03/2026

 

 

Request for Expression of Interest (EOI) (Technical Assistance Services)

Assignment Title: Technical Assistance services for the Project Preparatory Study of the Metro Dhaka Water Security and Resilience Program.

 

 

The Government of the People’s Republic of Bangladesh has received financing from the World Bank to implement a Technical Assistance project supporting the Metro Dhaka Water Security and Resilience Program. A portion of this financing will be used to procure consulting services to assist the Local Government Division under the Ministry of Local Government, Rural Development and Co-operatives in conducting a preparatory study for the Program.

The consulting services (“the Services”) will support the design and preparation of the Metro Dhaka Water Security and Resilience Program project through a range of integrated interventions. These include planning for sewerage, drainage, solid and fecal sludge management, rehabilitation of existing canals, and establishment of a pollution monitoring and enforcement system specifically for the Turag River. The Services will also focus on assessing technical, environmental, social, and institutional aspects of the program, and preparing actionable recommendations for project implementation across the Greater Dhaka Metropolitan area

The objectives of the assignment are:

  • Design sewerage networks in Aftabnagar and Banasree under the Dasherkandi catchment area and Gulshan–Banani Lake interceptor.
  • Design canal rehabilitation works.
  • Design the Fecal Sludge Management System (FSMS).
  • Design the Solid Waste Management System (SWMS).
  • Design the stormwater drainage system.
  • Conduct necessary surveys to support planning and design.
  • Identify and map point and non-point pollution sources.
  • Assess industrial compliance.
  • Identify locations for online monitoring systems.
  • Establish a water quality monitoring network with strategic sampling points.
  • Develop an enforcement framework..

Expected date for commencement of the services is July 2026 and the tentative duration of the entire assignment is about 10(Ten) months. A draft TOR can be found at the following website: www.lgd.gov.bd or can be obtained at the address of the undersigned given at the top of the letter head.

The Local Government Division (LGD) under the Ministry of Local Government, Rural Development and Cooperatives, Government of Bangladesh now invites eligible Consultancy Firms to express their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consulting firms should provide information demonstrating that they

 

have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services. The qualifications and experiences for short listing are:

 

  1. General Experience of the Firm in providing engineering services (core business and years in business)
  2. Experience in similar assignments of comparable size, complexity, and technical specialty in the required areas: Consultancy services for preparatory studies, integrated sewerage and drainage planning, solid and fecal sludge management, canal rehabilitation, and pollution monitoring system design for urban water security and resilience projects in metropolitan or large city settings.
  3. Experience in development partners funded Projects.

 

Consultants are requested to submit, but not limited to, the following supporting documents in support of the above-mentioned criteria:

  1. The Firm's Incorporation/Trade/registration documents from the country of the firm;
  2. Firm’s brochures; and
  3. description of similar consultancy contracts, including the scope, contract amount, name of Client, period of the contract (date of contract signing to date of completion), location/country of the services, etc.

 

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to Section III, Para 3.14, 3.16, and 3.17 of the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers, July 2016 and updated in November 2020,” setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.

 

A consulting firm is allowed to submit the expression of interest alone if it considers itself to be fully qualified on its own for the assignment, as it is not mandatory for consultants to associate with any other firm(s), whether foreign or local. Alternatively, if consultants themselves choose to associate to enhance their qualifications and capability for the assignment, then such associations may either be as a Joint Venture (i.e., all members of the joint venture shall be jointly and individually responsible) and/or Sub-consultants (i.e., the Consultant will be responsible, including for the services of the sub-consultant). In case of an association, the Consultants must explain in the EOI submission (a) the rationale for forming the association and (b) the anticipated role and relevant qualifications of each member of the Joint Venture and/or of each sub-consultant for carrying out the assignment, to justify the proposed inclusion of the JV members and/or sub-consultants in the association. Failure to provide the above explanation in the Expression of Interest may risk the association not being shortlisted for the assignment. However, the qualifications/experience of sub-consultants will not be considered by the Client in the evaluation of Expressions of Interest for Shortlisting purposes.

 

If shortlisted, Consultants will still have opportunity at the subsequent proposal preparation stage to further enhance their expertise for the assignment by associating with non-shortlisted consultants in the form of a Joint Venture or as Sub-consultants. In all such cases a shortlisted Consultant must obtain the written approval of the Client prior to the submission of the Proposal, for which the shortlisted Consultant will be required to justify the rationale for associating and specify the proposed role and relevant qualifications of the proposed associate(s) for carrying out the assignment. When associating with non-shortlisted firms in the form of a joint venture or a sub-consultancy, the shortlisted Consultant shall be the lead member. However, Instruction to Consultant (ITC) clauses of RFP will prevail in regards to association with non- shortlisted firms or sub-consultants during the proposal preparation stage.

 

A Consultancy Firm will be selected in accordance with the Quality and Cost Based Selection (QCBS)

method set out in the Procurement Regulations.

 

Further information can be obtained at the address of the undersigned given below, during office hours from 9:00 am to 5:00 pm Bangladesh Standard Time (BST):

procnotices.notice_text:
Sélection des CONSULTANTS PAR LES Emprunteurs de la Banque Mondiale

 

Sollicitation de Manifestations d’Intérêt pour le Recrutement d’un Consultant (Bureau)  pour la réalisation d’une enquête de mesure de la satisfaction des clients de la SONEDE

 

 

Date de l’avis : 16 mars 2026

 

  1. Contexte et justification du projet

 

La Société Nationale d’Exploitation et de Distribution de l’Eau (SONEDE) joue un rôle stratégique dans l’approvisionnement en eau potable des populations. Dans un contexte marqué par une demande croissante, des contraintes techniques et financières, ainsi que des exigences accrues en matière de qualité de service, la satisfaction des usagers constitue un indicateur clé de performance et de gouvernance du service public de l’eau.

 

Afin d’améliorer la qualité des services rendus, d’identifier les attentes des clients et de renforcer la relation usager–prestataire, la SONEDE envisage de réaliser une enquête de satisfaction auprès de ses clients. Cette enquête permettra de recueillir des données fiables sur la perception des usagers concernant l’accès au service, la continuité de l’approvisionnement, la qualité de l’eau, la facturation, la gestion des réclamations et la communication avec les clients.

Les résultats de cette enquête serviront d’outil d’aide à la décision pour orienter les réformes, améliorer les performances opérationnelles et renforcer la redevabilité de la SONEDE vis-à-vis de ses usagers.

 

  1. Objectifs de l’enquête

 

Mesurer le niveau de satisfaction des clients de la SONEDE afin d’identifier les forces, les insuffisances et les leviers d’amélioration du service de distribution d’eau potable.

 

  1. Objectifs spécifique  
  • Évaluer la perception des clients sur la qualité et la continuité du service d’eau potable;
  • Apprécier le niveau de satisfaction des usagers vis-à-vis des services commerciaux (facturation, paiement, accueil) ;
  • Analyser l’efficacité du traitement des plaintes et réclamations

 

  1. Champ de l’enquête  

L’enquête de satisfaction portera sur l’ensemble des services fournis par la SONEDE auprès de ses abonnés. Elle couvrira toutes les zones desservies par la société sur l’ensemble du territoire de l’Union des Comores, notamment dans les trois îles : Grande Comore, Anjouan et Mohéli.

L’enquête visera à recueillir les perceptions et le niveau de satisfaction des usagers concernant différents aspects du service d’alimentation en eau potable, notamment la qualité de l’eau, la continuité du service, la pression, la gestion des réclamations, l’accueil des clients ainsi que la facturation.

 

  1. Durée de la mission

 

La durée totale de la mission est estimée à 8 semaines, réparties entre la phase préparatoire, la collecte des données, l’analyse et la restitution des résultats.

 

  1. Les critères d’éligibilité et la procédure de sélection seront conformes aux procédures spécifiées dans le Règlement de Passation des Marchés de l’IDA pour les emprunteurs sollicitant le Financement de Projets d’Investissement (Sixième Edition fevrier-2025 « Sélection fondée sur les qualifications des consultants (SQC) ».

 

  1. Les consultants intéressés peuvent obtenir des informations supplémentaires et obtenir les termes des références à l’adresse ci-dessous et aux heures suivantes : de 08 heures à 16 heures (heure locale de Moroni – Union des Comores) du lundi au vendredi.

 

  1. Les manifestations d’intérêt doivent être déposées ou envoyées par email, aux adresses mentionnées ci-dessous au plus tard le lundi 06 avril 2026 à 14 heures (heure locale de Moroni – Union des Comores) ; adressé à Madame la Coordinatrice du Projet PNRSE « Manifestation d’intérêt N°2026/01/MEEH /PNRSE/ Enquête SONEDE»

 

  1. L’adresse à laquelle il est fait référence ci-dessus est : Projet National de Résilience du Secteur de l’Eau (PNRSE) Adresse : Moroni Volo volo en face d’Al Camar Email : coordinatrice.pnrse@gmail.com copie rpm.pnrsecomoros@gmail.com.

Request for Quotations

UKRAINE

Ukraine received the Loan No. 9238-UA from the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD) in US dollars to finance the Ukraine Improving Higher Education for Results Project and intends to use part of the funds to make payments under the Contract No. MOES-UIHERP-C2-MERGERS-55 “Procurement of a Genetic Analyzer”.

2. The Ministry of Education and Science of Ukraine invites eligible participants to submit proposals for the supply of a genetic analyzing equipment, including the following:

  • Genetic Analyzer.

More detailed information is provided in the Technical Specification.

The expected duration of the supply of Goods is 120 (one hundred twenty) days from the date of signing the contract.

3. The World Bank requires compliance with the Bank’s Anti-Corruption Guidelines and its applicable sanctions policies and procedures, as outlined in the World Bank Group Sanctions Framework. In further compliance with this policy, Bidders shall permit and require their agents (whether declared or not), subcontractors, sub-consultants, service providers, suppliers and personnel to permit the Bank to inspect all invoices, records and other documents relating to the request for quotations and execution of the contract (in case of award), as well as for their verification by auditors appointed by the Bank.

4. The participant provides at least the following additional documents as part of the offer:

  • Manufacturer’s authorization for the offered equipment (if applicable);
  • Information on the local authorized service department/company.

More detailed information is given in the Request for Quotations.

5. This is a national bidding procedure, and bids shall be submitted through any registered Prozorro platform. More information on how to register on Prozorro is available at the following link: https://infobox.prozorro.org/upload/files/main/2038/613/guide-for-non-residents-1502-2.pdf 

6.
